<cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:9">Snh. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>לא צריכא לה׳</he> the word <cite ref="L00170"><he>לוֹ</he></cite> is to intimate a liberal appropriation (for the army).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 306:6">Sifré Deut. 306</cite> <he>ואין לשון פתיחה אלא לשון ה׳</he> the word ‘opening’ has the meaning of comfort, opp. <he>לשון דוחק</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 43a:6">Keth. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>אלמנתו לא ניחא ליה בה׳ וכ׳</he> as to his widow he cares not for her living comfortably (from her own earnings besides the legal alimentation) &c.
